name: Data.isTameFor_of_hasWeight
summary: The four fields of IsTameFor: the modulus has places, the weight H, the tame part is non-trivial exactly at the places of the modulus, and the character is that of the tame part.

steps.claim: The modulus has places (`Data.nonempty_modulus_places`); the weight is H; the tame part ψ·ψ_ϑ is non-trivial exactly at the chosen places and the places of Q (`Data.places_modulus_eq_union`, b, the twist being non-trivial on Q and Q off the chosen places); the character is the given one.
steps.lean:
⟨nonempty_modulus_places, _, H, by grind [places_modulus_eq_union, Pi.mul_def, Twist, TameChar,
  IsChosen, → levelNorm_mem_and_notMem_of_mem_Q], rfl⟩
